admin.area_hint.notifications: Email templates and how people are told.
inbox.empty_desc: Records you follow, work assigned to you and reminders show here.
inbox.title: Notifications
nch.active_desc: When off, rules skip this channel and waiting messages are cancelled.
nch.delete_failed: The channel could not be deleted
nch.delete_text: Rules must stop using it first. Its delivery log is kept.
nch.editor_subtitle: The provider's address must be on the egress allowlist. Secrets are never shown again after saving.
nch.empty_text: Add an SMS provider or a messaging app such as Slack or Microsoft Teams.
nch.field_hint.body: Use {'{{'}to{'}}'}, {'{{'}title{'}}'}, {'{{'}text{'}}'} and {'{{'}link{'}}'} as whole values; they are filled in as JSON strings.
nch.field_hint.from: A phone number in international format or a messaging service ID.
nch.field_hint.method: POST unless the provider asks for PUT.
nch.field_hint.to: A conversation or group identifier your endpoint expects.
nch.field_hint.url: An https:// address on the egress allowlist.
nch.field_hint.webhook_url: Kept encrypted: whoever has it can post to the conversation.
nch.key_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores; rules refer to the channel by it.
nch.load_failed: The channels could not be loaded
nch.log_hint: Every message this channel sent or tried to send. Failed messages also appear in the Operations Center.
nch.name: Name
nch.provider_hint.messaging: One message is posted to the conversation the address belongs to.
nch.provider_hint.sms: Each recipient receives the message at the mobile number in their profile.
nch.rate_limit_hint: Messages beyond this wait for the next minute. Leave empty for no limit.
nch.save_failed: The channel could not be saved
nch.subtitle: Send notifications by text message or to a messaging app. Notification rules choose these channels besides email and in-app.
nch.test_after_save_text: A test message can be sent once the channel is saved.
nch.test_failed: The test message was not sent
nch.test_hint: Sends one message now with the saved settings.
nch.test_ok: The provider accepted the test message
nch.test_to_hint: A mobile number in international format, such as +966500000000.
notif.active_desc: Switch it off to stop sending without losing the rule.
notif.attachments_hint: The record’s files in these fields go with the email.
notif.condition_met_hint: People are told once each time it turns true, not on every save while it stays true.
notif.delay_hint: The rule is checked again when the wait is over.
notif.documents_hint: Generated for each message in its language, showing only what all its recipients may see.
notif.empty_text: Nobody is told about changes to this form’s records yet. Add a rule to tell people when a record is created, changes status, or needs attention.
notif.hint: Tell people when something happens to a record of this form: by email, in the notifications center, or both.
notif.mandatory: Send even to people who turned this channel off
notif.mandatory_desc: For notices people must not miss.
notif.name: Name
notif.only_if_desc: Send only for records where this condition holds.
notif.recipient.assignee: Whoever the record is assigned to
notif.recipient.creator: Whoever created the record
notif.recipient_field_none: This form has no user, role, department or email field, here or in the forms it links to.
notif.recipient_hint.assignee: A role or department assignment reaches its members. Read when the message is sent.
notif.recipient_hint.field: A user, role, department or email field of this form or of a form it links to. Read when the message is sent.
notif.recipient_hint.status_changer: The person behind the latest status change. Nobody when it was automatic.
notif.section.message_desc: Where it arrives, what it says and what it carries.
notif.template_hint: Also used for the title of in-app notifications.
notif.templates_hidden: Choosing an email template needs the Manage notifications permission.
notif.trigger.scheduled_reminder: A date comes near or passes
notif.who_hint: People in To, CC and BCC receive one message; a value only appears in it when every one of them may see it.
profile.channel_sms: By text message (SMS), to the mobile number in my profile
profile.notifications_hint: Choose how you are told. Some notices are mandatory and reach you anyway.
tpl.accent_hint: Used for the top border and buttons. Without one, the brand colour.
tpl.active_desc: An inactive template is not sent; rules that use it send nothing by email.
tpl.add_block_title: What should this part of the template show?
tpl.block.heading: Heading
tpl.block_desc.button: A button that opens the record or a web address.
tpl.block_desc.code: A QR code that opens the record, or a barcode of its number.
tpl.block_desc.fields: Chosen fields as label and value, each shown its own way.
tpl.block_desc.heading: A title for a part of the template, with values from the record.
tpl.block_desc.page_break: Starts a new page in the PDF and Word file.
tpl.block_desc.related: Records of another form that point at this record (payments of an invoice, visits of a case), with chosen columns.
tpl.block_desc.signature: Lines to sign on, for up to four people, with their names and a date line.
tpl.block_desc.table: The rows of a table in the form (order lines, items), with chosen columns.
tpl.block_desc.text: Paragraphs with values from the record; two asterisks on each side make text bold.
tpl.blocks_empty_text: The template is built from blocks: headings and text with values from the record, tables, signatures and more.
tpl.code.caption: Show the value under the code
tpl.code.caption_desc: For people who cannot scan it.
tpl.code.content_hint_link: Scanning it opens the record, for people allowed to see it.
tpl.code.content_hint_number: For scanners and filing; empty when the form gives no numbers.
tpl.conditional: Shown only when its condition holds
tpl.copied: Copied. Paste it where the value should appear.
tpl.delete_failed: The template could not be deleted.
tpl.delete_text: Delete the template “{name}”? Emails already sent keep their content.
tpl.editor_subtitle: Build the email from blocks; the preview shows it as a recipient receives it.
tpl.empty_text: Notification rules send email with a template. Create one to start.
tpl.fields_hint: Each recipient sees only the fields they may see.
tpl.form_hint: With a form, the template can show its fields and linked records.
tpl.format.title: How it is shown
tpl.load_failed: The templates could not be loaded.
tpl.logo_desc: The logo set in Appearance and branding, at the top of the email.
tpl.page_break_hint: What follows starts on a new page.
tpl.pick.field_hint: A field of this form or of a form it links to; open a link to reach its fields.
tpl.pick.title: Choose a value
tpl.placeholders_hint: Choose a value to copy its placeholder, then paste it into the subject or a text.
tpl.preheader_hint: Shown after the subject in most inboxes, and as the text of in-app notifications.
tpl.preview_as_hint: Without one, as you see it.
tpl.preview_failed: The preview could not be shown.
tpl.preview_invalid: Fix the problems listed to see the preview.
tpl.related_none: No form links to this one yet. Add a lookup to this form in another form first.
tpl.related_source_hint: A form whose records point at this record.
tpl.section.subject: Subject
tpl.show_when_hint: Leave empty to always show this block.
tpl.signature_date_desc: A line to write the date under each signature.
tpl.subject: Subject
tpl.subtitle: The emails the system sends: their wording, look and content in each language.
tpl.test_failed: The test could not be sent.
tpl.text_hint: A blank line starts a new paragraph. Two asterisks on each side make text bold.
